verdict.rationale: Bolna has a dedicated call-pricing docs page and states that BYOK or connected-provider components are not charged, so its pricing structure is partly documented. The pack quotes no actual per-minute or usage rates and no way to estimate cost per call. Missing for 10: published per-minute or usage rate figures, a cost-per-call estimation method or calculator, and independent confirmation of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing

citations.quote: When you bring your own keys (BYOK), Bolna does not charge for those components.
We don't charge for any usage for providers that you have connected to Bolna.
you can use your existing SIP trunk provider, your own phone numbers, and your own calling rates.
